description: Flaw 30, fixed with failed-remove-drops (conformance/models/README.md): a copy to t2 stopped once journaled, as kill -9 would, then t2 declared failed: nothing reads or writes it again, so no reprise ends that copy. disk remove of the failed disk drops it, undone in the catalog alone with an op-undone event, and takes t2 out.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[defaults]
settle = "0s"
replicas = 1
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"

steps.query: SELECT disk_id, kind, state FROM ops ORDER BY id
SELECT disk_id, kind, state FROM ops ORDER BY id
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind = 'op-undone'
SELECT id, state FROM disks ORDER BY position
